rubric.role_summary: Broadcast engineering role supporting live studio operations and designing on-premises, hybrid, and cloud production systems, including control-room workflows and live broadcasts.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Broadcast engineering role supporting live studio operations and designing on-premises, hybrid, and cloud production systems, including control-room workflows and live broadcasts.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Communications Technology, or similar, OR an equivalent mix of education and hands-on experience.
- Experience supporting live studio environments.
- Technical knowledge of broadcast studio production workflows.
- Knowledge of broadcast signal flow and networking.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- IP networking and SMPTE 2110 experience.
- Team collaboration and leadership experience.
- Background in automated or non-automated material handling systems.
- Technical knowledge of studio production and IP-driven broadcast workflows.
- Project and site management knowledge.
- Knowledge of signal flow, network architecture, and cloud IT infrastructure.
- Ability to craft and interpret technical documentation.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): New York metropolitan area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
